mechanical.title: Relax loop check-ins: SOW-gated autonomy, in-loop adjudication, self-merge, weekly ledger flush
warnings: 1 reviewer pass(es) absorbed a bodiless inline-comment review record alongside their announcement (cde5694aba×3). Counted as one round each, per reviewerPasses' announcement rule.

judgment.preOpenPreflightReason: Unknown. This record was written at the weekly flush by a session that did not run the loop, so no timestamp separates a pre-open preflight phase from the rest of the work. Recorded as null rather than fabricated as zero.
judgment.breakersFired: The rising-count tripwire never fired — findings fell monotonically (11/8/5/2/2). The OSCILLATION signal did, and was not acted on: rounds 3, 4 and 5 were entirely self-inflicted (5/5, 2/2, 2/2), each repairing an incomplete sweep left by the round before it, chasing the same two rules — the ledger carrier restriction and the stale-record sweep — through successive locations. working-modes.md names a round dominated by failures of the previous round's fixes as its own stopping condition precisely because prose cannot be executed; three consecutive such rounds is the pattern that rule exists to catch.

notes:
28 findings over 5 rounds. Round 1's 11 are all new_ground by construction. Round 2 splits 3 new_ground (the waiting:replit blocker-bucket rendering, the roadmap's stale deleted-Action entry, the stage:uat-before-sync gap) against 5 self-inflicted. Rounds 3, 4 and 5 are 9 further self-inflicted findings: every one is a location a previous round's fix failed to reach. Of the 14 self-inflicted, 12 are WRONG-FIX and 2 are propagation. The split follows working-modes.md's definitions literally: wrong-fix is an earlier fix in this loop that did not resolve what it claimed (the symptom persists or the fix is incomplete), and the sweep protocol explicitly classifies a sibling instance of a class an earlier round claimed to sweep as wrong-fix for the ledger's causal accounting. Only two findings are genuine propagation — a NEW defect the fix's own shape introduced rather than the same one recurring: round 2's adjudicated-stop wording newly authorizing prototyping before approval, and round 2's delivery-route wording newly admitting non-mergeable plan PRs as ledger carriers. Territory: all 14 new_ground are inDiff. Both findings this record originally called pre-existing are in files the diff DID touch — `docs/ai-context/current-roadmap.md` and `.claude/skills/status-all/SKILL.md` are both in commit 19ad5b8 — and the rubric splits on whether the loop's diff touched the surface, not on whether the loop authored the file.

CORRECTED at PR #461 round 1 (Codex, 7 findings, all confirmed against the source and applied; the class sweep they triggered found an eighth instance in #449's territory split that the review did not flag). Codex flagged the wrong-fix/propagation error on this record; the territory error here was found by sweeping the class it raised on #453 and #456 across every record in the flush.
